name: smwmusic-smart-ball-green-plains
title: Smart Ball - Green Plains
description:
A cancelled request from Green.

A song from the game Smart Ball (Jerry Boy), this track is upbeat and has a really nice trumpet solo! It's not a 1:1, but very close outside of a few instrument choices I could manage to find. Use this for your sunny grassland levels, cloud levels, or anything generally bright and cheery!
